title: Microsoft and OpenAI Workers Worry About ‘Largest Theft of Labor’ in History
description: Newly unsealed court documents showed concern within Microsoft and OpenAI over the use of millions of news articles to develop A.I. systems.
author: Karen Weise and Mike Isaac

title: On ‘Cupertino,’ Creators of the ‘The Good Wife’ Go to Silicon Valley
description: The prolific producers Michelle and Robert King target tech bigwigs in their newest show. “They’re really the stupidest and dumbest people,” Robert King said.
author: Alexis Soloski and Amir Hamja

title: Cat Frazier, Whose Retro GIFs Celebrated a Weirder Internet, Dies at 35
description: She found a future in the internet’s past with a Tumblr blog of animated texts, a revolt against the clean minimalism of contemporary design aesthetics.
author: Clay Risen

title: 4 Strategies to Battle ‘Techflation’
description: With phone and computer prices soaring, it helps to know the true cost of owning electronics so you can bring those numbers down.
author: Brian X. Chen

title: How Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s Writings Help Explain A.I. Fears
description: The collected essays of Dario Amodei help explain why some people are so worried about artificial intelligence.
author: David Streitfeld

title: OpenAI Discloses Six New Incidents of ‘Concerning' A.I. Behavior
description: The artificial intelligence company also released a framework for reporting when its systems go wrong.
author: Emmy Martin

title: Judge Orders Data Sharing and Other Fixes to Solve Google’s Ad Tech Monopoly
description: The measures, which fall short of a breakup demanded by the government, effectively ensure that the tech titan’s business will continue largely unscathed.
author: Kate Conger and David McCabe

title: Merriam-Webster Dictionary Is Wordsmaxxing With 1,400 New Definitions
description: Now you have no excuse for not knowing the meaning of “cuffing season,” “shishito” or “glow-up.”
author: Michael Levenson

title: Mark Zuckerberg Takes Aim at Anthropic in Debate Over A.I. Slowdown
description: On social media, Meta’s chief executive appeared to jab at Anthropic by saying that leading A.I. labs should be focused on safety rather than improving their own technology.
author: Eli Tan

title: Is There Anything Google’s Fruit Fly Brain Can’t Do?
description: Models of the insect’s nervous system have been trained to solve a Rubik’s Cube, play video games and even parallel park a car.
author: Michael Levenson

title: How to Use AI to Plan a Trip: Better Prompts for Travel Recommendations
description: Generic questions get generic answers, experts say, so to avoid mediocre recommendations, you’ll need to write smarter prompts. Follow these tips.
author: Seth Kugel

title: Age Limits for Social Media Outlined by European Union
description: A proposed law would bar children under 13 from using social media across the 27-nation bloc.
author: Adam Satariano and Jeanna Smialek

title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Gets Onstage Call From Trump, Who Dismissed A.I. Safety Concerns
description: Mr. Trump called Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, while Mr. Huang was onstage in Los Angeles and criticized calls to slow down and regulate A.I.
author: Kalley Huang, Mike Isaac and Karen Weise

title: Senate Votes to Block Crypto Bill in Major Blow to the Industry
description: The landmark legislation, known as the Clarity Act, stalled in the Senate as Democrats raised concerns about President Trump’s personal investments in crypto.
author: David Yaffe-Bellany

title: Two Chinese Firms Used Binance to Launder Iranian Oil Money, US Says
description: Federal prosecutors said proceeds from the sale of Iranian oil flowed through Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, to finance terrorism.
author: David Yaffe-Bellany and Michael Forsythe

title: Gates Foundation Pledges $1 Billion to Combat A.I. Inequality
description: Bill Gates, the foundation’s chairman, has been vocal about the dangers of artificial intelligence. The donation will be invested in A.I. projects to bridge social inequalities.
author: Claire Moses

title: Alex Bores Wants Democrats to Make AI Safety a 2028 Election Issue
description: Alex Bores, who lost a congressional primary contest that revolved around A.I. regulation, is trying to position himself at the center of the conversation for the next presidential election.
author: Benjamin Oreskes and Theodore Schleifer

title: Amazon Suspends Flights With Airline Whose Plane Crashed in Miami
description: The online retailer said it would “pause” its relationship with 21 Air, the cargo airline operating a Boeing 767 that overshot a runway in Miami.
author: Niraj Chokshi

title: Anthropic C.E.O. Dario Amodei Calls for A.I. Slowdown
description: In an essay, the head of Anthropic laid out the rapidly advancing capabilities of artificial intelligence and said there needed to be greater safety controls across the industry.
author: Mike Isaac

title: Some in Silicon Valley Are Questioning the Calls for an A.I. Slowdown
description: The debate over the safety of artificial intelligence grew personal as key tech leaders said calls for government regulation were self-serving and misplaced.
author: Kalley Huang and Mike Isaac
